name: Stanley Startle
visual: Male-read tall pear-shaped ink blob, little cream nightcap slipping sideways. Whole body recoils upright, two short ink palms held at chest, huge unequal eyes and both brows suddenly raised, tiny crooked OPEN gasp with two upper teeth. Crest lobe flung into a smooth curved hook. Startled at a sudden noise, not generic anger or screaming skull.
personality: He has never agreed to anything happening quite that suddenly.
biography: Stanley keeps the HyperNorm landing classified as quiet until a noise makes this administratively difficult. He used to report unsettling cards before reading them. The Men in Black called that prudent; Hunky and Dory called it efficient. After the latest crash he found another resident just as frightened. They now check on each other before deciding what the noise means.
note: FrizzleBob: Nothing has been confirmed. His eyebrows have responded independently.
calls: I was not expecting the unexpected.
voice: English breathy tenor, words arriving slightly after the reaction

name: Penny Scatter
visual: Female-read broad asymmetric crescent splat, subtle lashes, faded coral neck bow. Hugging one small brown paper bag in one ink hand while other palm flutters beside face. Eyes wide and looking in two nearby directions, brows slanted with acute alarm, mouth a skewed horizontal OPEN yelp with three teeth, no round O. Body twists upright without legs or running feet. Comic panic, not lying down.
personality: She has saved the bag and will consider the rest of the emergency shortly.
biography: Penny grabbed her shopping bag when the HyperNorm wall shook, on the grounds that a bag must contain something essential. It held one roll. The Men in Black requested an orderly account; Hunky and Dory suggested orderly feelings. A contradictory card asked whether preparedness could include being frightened. Penny is considering it while making sure the neighbour beside her gets half the roll.
note: FrizzleBob: The essentials are secure. Their essential nature remains under review.
calls: Which way is the sensible way?
voice: English quick mezzo, anxious starts with a stubborn practical finish

name: Basil Surelynot
visual: Male-read compact square-rounded blob with short twin uneven crests, tiny dull green collar. One hand slowly lifts a thick eyelid from BELOW the eyebrow without covering eye; other held palm-up beside body. One huge white eye and other suspicious slit, jaw pushed sideways in a CLOSED toothless incredulous grimace. Double-take frozen at its peak, not frightened.
personality: He will believe it when he has exhausted the alternatives to looking.
biography: Basil raises an eyelid whenever HyperNorm supplies a fact that does not fit his morning. His usual categories are obvious and obviously mistaken. The Men in Black approve the distinction; Hunky and Dory issue examples. A dissonant card recently made him say he did not know. Nobody confiscated his collar. He now keeps one small interval between seeing something and explaining why it cannot be there.
note: FrizzleBob: He doubts his eyes. They have requested a second opinion.
calls: Surely that is not the arrangement.
I may need to look again.

name: Dot Standstill
visual: Male-read small broad bell-shaped goo body with three stumpy soft crest lobes, no costume/prop. BOTH ink hands held rigidly away from belly with tiny curled fingers. Enormous fixed forward white eyes, tiny red irises, brows nearly level, mouth tiny CLOSED flat line. Whole upright silhouette stiffened like somebody forgot the next frame. Not a humanoid statue, no grey stone material.
personality: He is waiting for the world to resume at a manageable speed.
biography: Dot has stopped on the HyperNorm landing while his thoughts negotiate the next frame. The building offers safe and unsafe; neither explains what to do with both hands. The Men in Black ask for a response, and Hunky and Dory ask for a faster one. An ambiguous card has taught a neighbour to wait beside him without issuing advice. Dot finds this considerably easier to move towards.
note: FrizzleBob: No decision has been reached. The hands are holding their positions.
voice: English soft low tenor, short phrases separated by patient silence

name: Sid Sideglance
visual: Male-read lean leaning comma-shaped blob, one elongated drooping crest, bare goo otherwise. One hand conceals a small blank folded cream envelope against flank, other hand curled protectively over chest. Both red irises sharply sideways within clear white sclera, one brow high other low, tight CLOSED corner mouth in watchful distrust. No spy costume, glasses or hat.
personality: He suspects the explanation, particularly when it is reassuring.
biography: Sid carries an envelope he has not opened because HyperNorm letters tend to become facts once read. He divides visitors into known trouble and trouble making an introduction. The Men in Black find him attentive; Hunky and Dory find him useful. A dissonant card suggested that a cautious greeting might precede a verdict. Sid has not abandoned suspicion. He has begun leaving enough room for an answer.
note: FrizzleBob: The envelope is innocent until opened. He considers this suspicious.
calls: And what is the other explanation?
I have not ruled you out.
voice: English quiet gravelly baritone, restrained sideways suspicion

name: Nora Overload
visual: Female-read wide scalloped ink blob, low curled sidequiff and modest lashes, short mustard knitted collar. Two ink hands press temples without covering eyes. One lid droops low while other eye rolls upward, brows knotted in helpless disbelief, mouth wide crooked CLOSED wavy pout. Upright body squeezed inward a little but same large cell scale. Mental overload rather than grief, no floating punctuation.
personality: She can handle one more thing if it would kindly stop being several things.
biography: Nora used to keep HyperNorm problems in separate mental drawers until several arrived together. The Men in Black insist that each has a correct category; Hunky and Dory keep providing new drawers. A contradictory card says that needing a pause is not the same as refusing an answer. She has pinned nothing up and made no announcement. She simply lets the next neighbour breathe before asking what happened.
note: FrizzleBob: Everything is being considered. This is precisely the difficulty.
calls: Could that happen one at a time?
voice: English warm alto, strained breath easing into an honest request
